The '''Junction-Tierell Loop''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] loop largely in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] that traversed from [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] to [[Tierell]], both on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The systems it served were known as the [[Loop Worlds]]. The loop circled the [[Denarii Nebula/Legends|Denarii Nebula]] on its way through the Reach to [[The Roil/Legends|The Roil]] and back to [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tierell is incorrectly spelled "Tierrel" on the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] map of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
